text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is setting SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you must provide. Before starting, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals. This alignment prevents misunderstandings and keeps everyone working toward the same outcome. When goals, milestones, and deliverables are clear and shared, projects are much more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
